text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to sit at my desk and get some
work
done, when...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
From under the desk comes... Drum roll,
please! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I wanted to hang out with you, so
I've been
waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nothing gets my engines going
lately—not even
racing or hanging out
with my friends...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Even now, they're barely
purring...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's still feeling tired. Going
forward, I
should probably reevaluate
her race schedule to
ensure her best
performance.
